size.$description: The trailing slot: one fixed box that holds the spinner, the tick or the error icon in turn, so nothing shifts (F2).

stroke.$description: The tick's and the circle's line.

tick.$description: The commit colour: the confirmed tick and circle, at least 3:1 against the field.

tickFill.$description: The quiet fill inside the confirmed circle.

draw.$description: The tick drawing itself in; reduced motion shows it fully drawn at once.

gap.$description: Between the failure line's words and its Retry and Revert.

fontSize.$description: The failure line, the size of a field's error.
